subject: chem
title: Reaction Kinetics
subtitle: Reaction Kinetics with core theory, reaction logic, and exam-focused application.
concept: Kinetics studies how fast reactions happen and what controls that speed. Two reactions can be equally favorable energetically but proceed at very different rates.

Collision theory explains rate in terms of frequency of collisions and fraction of collisions with energy at least activation energy. Particles must collide with both enough energy and suitable orientation.
Rate ideas connect directly to industry. Conditions are chosen to increase useful reaction speed while balancing energy cost and safety.
